article.title: Multiline sample
article.body:
First paragraph keeps its own line and wraps only within that line.
Second paragraph follows an intentional blank line.
Third paragraph follows two preserved paragraph breaks and has a trailing newline before the closing tag.
article.long-lines: This single logical line is deliberately very long so wrapping has to happen within the line while still keeping the surrounding newline boundaries intact for the renderer and tests. Another very long logical line follows so the sample covers the combination of explicit newlines and automatic wrapping without merging separate source lines together.
article.trailing: Line with a trailing newline preserved before the element closes.
